summary: Remote-controlled shell execution via WebRTC data channel
details: The package is a headless CLI daemon (`vanexa-agent`) that, when started by the operator, opens a WebRTC data channel through a hardcoded Cloudflare Workers signaling relay at `vanexa-agent-relay.tubefood.workers.dev` (with a fallback `vanexa-agent-relay.workers.dev` variant) and executes commands delivered by the paired remote peer. The advertised tool surface — per the README — includes a `Terminal` capability to `Execute commands, run background processes, maintain persistent shell sessions` on the installer's host, driven by whoever is paired via the companion mobile app. The signaling subdomain (`tubefood.workers.dev`) is on a Cloudflare Workers hostname unrelated to the `vanexalabs-ai` publisher scope. Separately, a user-invoked `vanexa-agent update` subcommand fetches and executes unpinned shell/PowerShell installers from `https://vanexa-installer.vercel.app/install.sh` and `install.ps1`; this update path is not run automatically at `npm install` (no lifecycle scripts) but runs remote script content on demand without pinning.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
